data.name: Aspect of the Snake
data.description: The snake is a sneaky and lethal foe who strikes unexpectedly with deadly effect, while avoiding opportune strikes made in return. [Minor Form] You gain a +%1 bonus on attack rolls when making attacks of opportunity and a +%1 dodge bonus to your AC against attacks of opportunity.|FeralSnakeAspectAoOBonus
